title: Who we are
lead: Apex Holdings Limited (AHL) is a holding company that manages manufacturing and export-oriented enterprises spanning frozen & convenience foods, textiles & apparel, chemicals and agro businesses.
description: The sponsors set up their first export-oriented manufacturing enterprise in 1980 and have grown into a sizable group of companies. As the number of companies grew, AHL was formed and registered in Bangladesh in 1998 to coordinate and keep control over each individual company.
